ruleDefinitions.name: Whoami.EXE Execution With Output Option
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of "whoami.exe" with the "/FO" flag to choose CSV as output format or with redirection options to export the results to a file for later use.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\whoami\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "whoami\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/FO\\ CSV.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-FO\\ CSV.*"))) OR process_command_line = RGX(".*whoami*\\>.*")
